cases.prompt: Build a launch email in my Figma file using our synced Email Love components.

must_do: send only the customer source render to the converter

cases.prompt: Build this campaign with our Email Love library, but create the missing comparison block if no component fits.
must_do: use Path A where components fit
confirm the component gap with the user
use Path B render rules for the missing module
must_not_do: flatten the comparison block without user approval

cases.prompt: Audit this legacy email design system for migration. Do not change the source file.
Migrate this whole legacy library into Email Love.
must_do: obtain human confirmation of blocking judgments
build in a separate target file
convert no more than five modules per batch
must_not_do: convert the whole library in one pass

cases.prompt: Build this Email Love email, but the connected Figma tools only expose screenshots and metadata.
must_do: state that the Figma connection is read-only
offer an email plan or AI Import handoff
must_not_do: generate a fake email image as completion
